products.name: ZELSUVMI (berdazimer) topical gel, 10.3%
products.description: A prescription topical gel for the treatment of molluscum contagiosum, manufactured using proprietary nitric oxide-based NITRICIL technology, distributed through retail and mail order pharmacies, and can be applied at home by patients or caregivers.

products.name: XEPI (ozenoxacin) Cream, 1%
products.description: A prescription topical antimicrobial cream for the treatment of impetigo due to Staphylococcus aureus or Streptococcus pyogenes, acquired and to be relaunched after manufacturing and regulatory validation, distributed through pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: XEGLYZE (abametapir) topical solution
products.description: A prescription topical medication for the treatment of head lice infestation, acquired for worldwide commercialization, to be launched after completion of manufacturing and regulatory activities.

products.name: Earth Observation Data Subscriptions

products.description: On-demand high-resolution imaging of specific locations using company-owned or customer-owned satellites, including dedicated image tasking capacity and rapid revisit capabilities, delivered digitally via API or platform.

products.name: Satellite Mission Services

products.description: Operation of a licensed waste disposal site at Shirley Basin for 11e.(2) byproduct material from other in situ uranium mines, involving regulated acceptance, handling, and disposal of radioactive waste materials under long-term contracts.

products.name: Aquablation Therapy Systems (AquaBeam and HYDROS Robotic Systems)
products.description: Advanced, image-guided surgical robotic systems designed and manufactured for minimally invasive urologic surgery, primarily for the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). These systems use proprietary heat-free waterjet ablation technology, real-time imaging, and automated robotics, and are delivered as capital equipment to hospitals and surgical centers, with procedures performed using a single-use disposable handpiece.

products.name: Single-Use Disposable Handpieces for Aquablation Therapy
products.description: Proprietary, single-use disposable handpieces designed for use with the AquaBeam and HYDROS Robotic Systems to deliver Aquablation therapy. These are consumable products required for each surgical procedure and are manufactured and distributed by the company.

products.name: Aquablation Therapy Procedure Services
products.description: Provision of Aquablation therapy as a surgical procedure for the treatment of BPH and, in clinical trials, localized prostate cancer. products.name: Pan-Coronavirus Antiviral (D-MAV)
products.description: A peptide conjugate therapeutic, delivered as a nasally inhaled spray, designed for prophylactic and therapeutic prevention of SARS-CoV-2 and other human-infecting coronaviruses, especially for immunocompromised patients. Manufactured using proprietary solid-phase peptide synthesis and AI-driven design for rapid optimization and scale-up.

products.name: Broad Respiratory Antiviral (Flu/COVID-19/RSV)
products.description: A single peptide conjugate antiviral targeting the conserved fusion mechanism across influenza, COVID-19, and RSV, intended for self-administration to treat or prevent respiratory tract infections. Developed using the IMP3ACT platform with rapid synthesis and optimization for broad-spectrum activity.

products.name: Peptide-based Proteolysis Targeting Chimeras (P-PROTACs)
products.description: A novel class of peptide conjugate therapeutics that use engineered peptides to target intracellular proteins for degradation, leveraging the SP-3164 small molecule as an E3 ligase binder. These are manufactured using proprietary peptide synthesis and AI-driven design, aiming to address 'undruggable' targets in viral and host proteins.

products.name: Small Molecule Oncology Therapeutics (SP-2577)
products.description: A legacy small molecule LSD-1 inhibitor program (seclidemstat/SP-2577) for oncology indications, developed through traditional small molecule drug discovery and clinical trials. The company is seeking strategic alternatives, including potential out-licensing, for this asset.

products.name: IT Hardware Products

products.description: Depot repair and warranty services for major IT systems and hardware, including in-house and manufacturer-authorized repairs, provided through a certified technology integration and distribution center.

products.description: A suite of products including library preparation kits, target enrichment panels, exome kits, workflow solutions, and RNA sequencing workflows, manufactured using silicon-based DNA synthesis to enable accurate, high-throughput sample preparation and analysis for NGS applications in diagnostics, research, and genomics.

products.name: Synthetic Controls
products.description: Positive synthetic DNA controls manufactured using the DNA synthesis platform, provided for quality control in assay development and routine testing for NGS and RT-PCR applications.

products.name: IgG Proteins
products.description: Recombinant immunoglobulin G (IgG) proteins produced via automated, high-throughput processes using mammalian cell lines (CHO and HEK293), supporting drug discovery and antibody development workflows with standard and Express turnaround options.

products.name: Biopharma Services for Antibody Discovery and Development
products.description: Comprehensive discovery services including in vivo, in vitro, and in silico antibody discovery, library generation, screening, developability assays, and antibody expression/characterization, provided as fee-for-service, licensing, and milestone-based partnerships to biopharma customers.

products.description: Tetra-specific fusion protein therapeutics (Dual Targeting TriKE®) that engage NK cells and target multiple tumor antigens simultaneously, produced via advanced recombinant protein engineering and delivered as injectable biologics for cancer treatment.

products.name: TriKE® Immunotherapies for Autoimmune Disorders
